British American Tobacco to slash jobs as it shifts to AI

British American Tobacco is cutting about a fifth of its workforce, aiming to reduce costs and become more technology-enabled. The move comes as the company shifts towards smoke-free alternatives. This change will impact around 9,000 employees globally.
